verdict.rationale: Jira markets Rovo AI for breaking down tasks and auto-assigning to the right person, identifying trends/bottlenecks, and creating automations, which are adjacent to triage/prioritization, but there is no explicit documentation of an AI feature that specifically triages or prioritizes incoming bugs/tasks. missing for 10: explicit bug/task triage-and-prioritization AI feature docs, independent/hands-on confirmation that Rovo AI performs this triage reliably.
